title: The Edge of the Forest
offer: Kol and Ingrid want sheep for their new home. Bring them two sheep, and I give you the strip of land by the forest, next to your farm. A fair trade!

steps.say: Two sheep for the young ones! Ingrid already knits. The forest edge is yours: good wood and two fields.

fact: Land was traded for animals, silver or work: there were no banks.
